Regulation 31(4) mandates disclosure when an acquirer's shareholding crosses prescribed thresholds or when a public announcement is required. The disclosure was filed on or around 24 June 2026. The full details of shareholding quantum, acquisition price, payment method, and any conditions precedent or exemptions are contained in the filed disclosure document.
